summary: Validated mobile responsiveness fix for Omaha8 Advisor at 390x844, 360x800, and desktop 1280x800. NO horizontal overflow at any viewport; scrollWidth == clientWidth in all three cases. All four card triggers, all action buttons, popover, results panels, and camera dialog fit within the mobile viewport. Rank change (Q on card 1) triggered re-evaluation and decision-panel/metrics/scoop/teaching panels all rendered.

iphone_390x844.buttons_in_viewport: evaluate/reset/scan-photo/camera/share all in viewport, wrap onto multiple rows

test_details.popover_interaction: card-trigger-1 tap opens card-popover-1 (box 0,393 256x202) within 390 viewport; clicking rank-1-Q updates card and re-evaluates; decision-panel + metric-low/high/fit/risk + scoop-panel + teaching-panel all visible.
test_details.camera_dialog_mobile: camera-btn opens camera-dialog with box x=0 y=214 width=390 height=415, fits entirely within 390x844 viewport. Post-open scrollWidth still 390 (no overflow). getUserMedia shim via add_init_script with canvas.captureStream worked.

critical_code_review_comments: Responsive fix is effective: PlayingCard w-[64px] h-[92px] on mobile scaling to sm:w-[104px] sm:h-[148px] prevents overflow at 360/390 widths.
overflow-x-hidden on the Evaluator container is a safety net; primary fix is proper responsive sizing (good).
Consider aria-label/role improvements on card-trigger buttons for accessibility (non-blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile responsiveness fully validated at 360, 390, and 1280 widths. No horizontal overflow. Camera dialog getUserMedia was shimmed via page.add_init_script with canvas.captureStream(30). Backend not re-tested per request (already passed in iters 1-3).
